page.overview:
What is Emergency?

Emergency is a subtheme of LEGO Town and City, and includes vehicles and buildings of the Emergency Medical Services. Only two Town sets were released.

Emergency was first introduced in the 1980s as a Town subtheme, including several sets. After that, no new sets were released for almost 20 years. In 2006, City released four new hospital sets. The following year two smaller sets were released. City introduced another two new emergency-related sets in 2012.
